fields.summary_ko.0: Seagate Technology Holdings plc (STX) achieved record profitability in Q1 FY27 (non-GAAP EPS $7.68) and record free cash flow of $1.48 billion, benefiting from increased AI storage demand.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q1 non-GAAP revenue of $4.23 billion (+61% YoY), Q2 guidance of $4.8 billion with HAMR technology and expanded high-capacity Mozaic drives, annual gain of 77.6% but down 53.3% from 52-week high of $1,094.
